financial_score_info_icon.position: Top-right corner of Financial Score widget

info_tooltip_toggle.tooltip_content: Explains how score is calculated with 4 components

components.name: Savings Rate
components.description: % of income saved after all expenses. >30% = full marks.

components.name: EMI Load
components.description: EMI-to-income ratio from your loans. <25% = full marks.

components.name: Safety Buffer
components.description: Months of expenses covered by liquid funds. >6 months = full marks.

components.name: Income Consistency
components.description: How stable your income has been over 3 months. Low variance = full marks.
